name: Composition
description: Chemical composition of a battery material or component. Captures substance name, CAS number and weight fraction. Supports hazardous substance disclosure under EU Battery Regulation Art. 13 and REACH.

leaf_properties.label: Substance (from vocabulary)
leaf_properties.description: Select substance from the battery substances vocabulary (SKOS). Concept IRIs resolve to PubChem. Leave blank and use the free-text field below for unlisted substances.

leaf_properties.label: Substance Name (free text)
leaf_properties.description: IUPAC or common name for substances not in the vocabulary. Use this as fallback or override.

leaf_properties.label: CAS Number
leaf_properties.description: Chemical Abstracts Service registry number (e.g. 7439-93-2 for Lithium). Auto-populated from skos:notation when vocabulary entry is selected.

leaf_properties.label: Weight Fraction (%)
leaf_properties.description: Weight percentage of this substance in the parent material (0–100).

leaf_properties.label: Hazardous Substance
leaf_properties.description: True if this substance is classified as hazardous under REACH Regulation (EC) No 1907/2006.

metadata.regulation: EU Battery Regulation 2023/1542 Art. 13; REACH (EC) No 1907/2006
metadata.note: target_class uses DPPO dpp-core:Material. schema.org/chemicalComposition is a property, not a class.
